scoring_justification: No raw computational artifacts (phonon dynamical matrices, electron-phonon matrix elements) are submitted; only final λ, ω_log, Tc values. Compare to paper-reported gold with tolerances and verify trend monotonicity.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for lattice constants, EPC parameters, and XRD expected peak positions.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I (lattice constants) and Table II (λ, ω_log, Tc) for PtH phase at 113, 130, 160 GPa. XRD peaks derived from the known crystal structure (P6_3/mmc, Wyckoff positions) and lattice constants a=2.70 Å, c=4.53 Å with λ=0.3344 Å.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Lattice and EPC values extracted verbatim from paper tables. XRD peak positions computed analytically from d-spacings and structure factor conditions using standard crystallographic formulas; intensities not used for scoring, only peak positions.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual paper-reported values needed for reproduction comparison; they are the only authoritative reference for the paper's own computational result.

outputs.description: DFT-optimized hexagonal lattice constants of P6₃/mmc PtH at 113, 130, and 160 GPa. Compared to hidden reference values with a small absolute tolerance.

Electron-phonon coupling strength λ, logarithmic average phonon frequency ω_log, and superconducting transition temperature Tc at three pressures. Hidden checker compares to paper-reported values and verifies Tc monotonicity.
Simulated powder XRD pattern at 113 GPa, wavelength 0.3344 Å. The hidden checker validates peak positions and relative intensities against a reference.

output_contract.notes: All scored outputs are re-derived from first-principles calculations. The hidden checker uses paper-reported values and simulated patterns as reference, with tolerances appropriate for the change in DFT code (VASP to Quantum ESPRESSO) and pseudopotential.
